digest.component_or_area: Reconciler outbound differ and vendor adapter seam
propositions: The outbound differ compares vendor-shaped fields while the inbound differ compares canonical-shaped fields, creating an asymmetry that violates ADR 0035 section (d) and blocks epic bbf1 AC3.
The outbound update path must canonicalize the Jira snapshot via InboundMapper.map_remote_to_local before field comparison, mirroring the inbound differ's canonicalization at ingestion.

Vendor-shaped field comparison helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches, _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE) must become adapter-internal; core must use neutral canonical-name helpers for status, priority, assignee, parent, labels, and description diffing.

The OutboundMapper must gain map_fields_to_remote(local_fields) to emit vendor payloads only at the emission boundary, taking changed local-name→value pairs and returning only the vendor-shaped subset needed for the update.

The InboundMapper output must widen to include three new canonical aliases (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) with fixed shapes, presence-guarded for partial _BASELINE_FIELDS subsets, and map_remote_to_local must tolerate partial dicts without defaulting absent keys.

The characterization test suite must prove decision-for-decision equivalence (no-emit/emit decisions and payload byte-identity) across all status/priority maps, assignee shapes, parent changes, baseline-driven conflict detection, and the non-authoritative resolver fallback.
